pick.name: Tousle the Curly-Ruff Cat
pick.description: Tousle, a tawny-gold cat with a thick curly russet ruff and honey eyes, lounges in the white garden flowers like it's her stage. A cat coin priced in SPHR. Not affiliated with Sphere Entertainment Co., Backpack Securities or StonkFun. No intrinsic value; not financial advice.
